titel: Free or controlled internet? The great DSA debate
beschrijving: In December 2020, European Commission President Ursula Von Der Leyen announced the Digital Services Act at Web Summit. In an effort to combat hate speech and online misinformation, the legislation has become a crucial part of how European regulators address harms caused by online platforms. However, free expression advocates have warned of threats to free speech under the guise of tackling incitement. Our panel asks: Is the DSA necessary to combat big tech or an effort to control online discourse?
sprekers: Alexandra Geese (MEP, The European Parliament); Balázs Orban (MEP, European Parliament); Arba Kokalari (MEP, European Parliament); Mike Benz (Executive Director of the Foundation For Freedom Online, Foundation For Freedom Online); Luc Chénier (CEO, Kyiv Post)

titel: Galbot: The robots have clocked in
beschrijving: The robots are already showing up for work. From robot-run convenience stores to pharmacies across China, Galbot’s humanoids have moved past the flashy demo and into everyday life. beschrijving:

sprekers: Alex Halliday (Co-founder and CEO, AirOps)

titel: How AI actors are creating entertainment's next frontier
beschrijving: Are AI actors a threat to human performance, or the arrival of a new art form? AI actress Tilly Norwood and her creator Eline van der Velden present a new vision for the future of film and TV. In this session we ask how synthetic performers can sit harmoniously alongside traditional entertainment as a separate, thriving industry built for the next generation of digital-native audiences.
sprekers: Eline van der Velden (Founder & CEO, Particle 6); Tilly Norwood (Actress, Particle 6); Mosheh Oinounou (Founder and CEO, Mo News)

titel: Capital without gatekeepers in the next financial frontier
beschrijving: In the next financial frontier, access to capital is shifting away from traditional gatekeepers and toward decentralised, democratised ecosystems. This panel examines how modernised regulations and flexible funding frameworks can eliminate systemic hurdles.

titel: The open source advantage

Move past the hype to discover why the future of AI is fast, flexible, and open source.

titel: The future of Europe: Can it stand on its own feet?
beschrijving: For decades, Europe has depended on the US not only for its security, but also for much of its technological and financial infrastructure. As the transatlantic relationship continues to fracture, Europe faces a question much bigger than how to spend more on defence. Can it reduce its dependence on American technology, capital and financial infrastructure while building the industrial capacity to defend itself? And can it do so without sacrificing prosperity and the welfare state?

This session explores what's driving this divide between the streets and the strategists, whether social media is to blame, and if this surge of content can inspire real-world change.

titel: Better living at home: Display for real. AI for reality
beschrijving: Display technology and AI are evolving rapidly, but their greatest potential lies in how they work together. Advances in display technology deliver more lifelike visual experiences, while AI better understands people, environments and daily needs. Through perspectives on RGB display tech, contextual intelligence and connected services, this keynote unpacks how technology can become more natural, useful and human-centred, creating better experiences that improve everyday life.
sprekers: Dennys Li (President, Hisense Visual Technology)

titel: Everything will be simulated
beschrijving: The next frontier of AI isn't making Hollywood clips – it's building interactive, real-time simulations of the physical world. Join Runway CTO Kamil Sindi as he outlines the rise of General World Models and shows how moving beyond static 2D frames to dynamic, cause-and-effect environments unlocks the future of spatial computing, robotics, and interactive media.
sprekers: Kamil Sindi (CTO, Runway); John Koetsier (Forbes columnist & Tech First Podcast Host, Forbes, Freelance)

titel: Machine-ready brands: A playbook for the Intelligence Age
beschrijving: Customers are getting used to agents doing the browsing, deciding, even the buying on their behalf. Once someone's used to that, a static ad or a fixed website starts to feel broken. They expect brands to meet them with the same fluency: responsive, individualized, always-on. This talk explores what it takes to define a brand for both humans and machines, and build the systems that keep it consistent, current, and everywhere your customers now expect to find it.
sprekers: Nick Pringle (Chief Creative Officer EMEA, R/GA)

titel: Are job interviews real anymore?
beschrijving: Behind viral social clips of applicants using AI to cheat virtual interviews lies a threat to corporate security: synthetic candidates infiltrating core enterprise systems. As generative video, real-time voice cloning and AI-inflated profiles proliferate, traditional candidate verification is failing. In this session we examine the mechanics of the fake candidate epidemic. In this session we explore how to shut down synthetic fraud before it reaches the payroll.
sprekers: Mahe Bayireddi (CEO & co-founder, Phenom); Tom Allen (Founder, Tiny Media / The AI Journal)
organisaties: Phenom; Tiny Media / The AI Journal

titel: Rethinking venture capital
beschrijving: As market cycles tighten and exits take longer, standard financial backing isn't enough to help startups succeed. Modern venture capital requires a complete support structure to lower risk and speed up growth. This session focuses on what it takes to turn complex ideas into durable, market-ready companies.
sprekers: Tala Al Jabri (Founder & Managing Partner, Wyld VC); RJ Schuurs (Partner, Antler); Sarah Kunst (Founder & Managing Director, Cleo Capital); Nalin Patel (Director of Research, PitchBook)

titel: In the age of AI, trust is still human

sprekers: Denise Johansson (Co-founder & CEO, Enfuce); Evan Bourke (Journalist & Producer, Independent)

titel: The AI paradox: Smarter models, disappointing results
beschrijving: AI models are becoming more powerful at a breathtaking pace. So why aren't businesses seeing the transformation they were promised? Glean CEO Arvind Jain challenges the industry's obsession with model intelligence alone, examines what AI companies are getting wrong about context, and explores what it will actually take to turn AI's extraordinary capabilities into real-world impact.
sprekers: Arvind Jain (Founder & CEO, Glean)

titel: The battery is the new barrel

sprekers: Luis Santiago Pinto (Co-founder & CEO, Powerdot); Linh Austin (President & CEO, R3 Lithium); Maeve Campbell (Journalist, Channel 4 News)

titel: The future has a following
beschrijving: From TikTok to the Times, traditional media is turning to creators to rebuild relationships with audiences who have turned away. In a bid to stay relevant, legacy outlets are enlisting creator clout to stay in the conversation. But does this represent a genuine, long-term partnership – or is it merely a temporary fix while traditional media tries to catch up.
sprekers: Mimi Yates (Multimedia Reporter, The Daily Mail); Vitus Spehar (Creator of Under The Desk News, Under The Desk News); Aidan Kohn-Murphy (Founder & Executive Director, Gen-Z for Change); Rebecca Hutson (Editor-in-chief, The News Movement)

titel: Your AI agent just got a passport

sprekers: Benjamin Faes (CEO, RWS Group); Elena Poughia (Managing Editor, Dataconomy Media)

titel: Chat Control 2.0: The government in your DMs?
beschrijving: As Europe debates new measures to combat child sexual abuse online, where should the line be drawn between protecting children and protecting private communications? This talk explores the implications for privacy, encryption, and digital freedom, and whether “private” messages could soon mean something very different.
sprekers: Michael McNamara (MEP, The European Parliament); Thomas Fazi (Author, UnHerd); Mathias Stamm (Editor-in-Chief, Deutsche Welle)
organisaties: The European Parliament; UnHerd; Deutsche Welle

titel: From 'For You' to 'For Me': The new path from discovery to action
beschrijving: On TikTok, people watch it, love it, want it – and increasingly, those moments happen almost all at once. What starts as entertainment can spark curiosity, inspire a search, shape a decision and drive action, reshaping the traditional path from awareness to purchase. This talk explores how this new era of discovery is changing marketing, from the growing influence of creators and communities to the role of AI in creativity, and how brands can turn cultural relevance into real business growth.
sprekers: Isobel Sita-Lumsden (Global Head of Business Marketing, TikTok); Kaya Yurieff (Co-Founder & Co-CEO, Scalable, Scalable)

titel: Live Podcast: The Big Technology Podcast with Atlassian
beschrijving: If Software Was Dead, Why Are We Sitting Here? AI agents were supposed to destroy software companies, But so far, that prediction looks premature or wrong. Atlassian co-founder Mike Cannon-Brookes joins Big Technology’s Alex Kantrowitz to examine why SaaS has held up and what happens as agents start operating software on our behalf. In this talk, they’ll explore whether organisational context (not necessarily model intelligence) is becoming the key advantage in enterprise AI, whether the traditional software interface survives, and where, if at all, the “Saaspocalypse” worries had merit.
sprekers: Mike Cannon-Brookes (Co-founder & CEO, Atlassian); Alex Kantrowitz (Founder & Host, Big Technology Podcast)

titel: Is it time to unify the global payment stack?
beschrijving: As global commerce expands and payment ecosystems fragment across regional rails, alternative methods, and legacy architectures, managing transactions efficiently has become a bottleneck for enterprise growth. beschrijving: As BRICS expand their economic, political, and technological influence, Europe faces a fundamental question. How should it navigate a world where power is increasingly dispersed beyond the traditional Western order? This conversation explores Europe’s evolving relationship with China, Brazil, and the wider BRICS grouping; and whether Europe can forge a more independent and constructive role in the emerging multipolar order.

titel: The orchestration gap: Fixing the enterprise’s AI problem

titel: Building the pan-European bank: Scale, governance and European growth
beschrijving: Revolut is achieving what few tech companies manage: building a unified European bank at scale. Fresh off securing a full French banking licence, the company is launching a second EU hub to serve more than 30 million customers. Join Revolut western Europe CEO Béatrice Cossa-Dumurgier to examine what it takes to navigate fragmented policy, unify tech with local banking infrastructure, and compete with legacy finance.
sprekers: Beatrice Cossa-Dumurgier (CEO for Western Europe, Revolut); Anita Hawser (Europe Editor, The Banker (Financial Times))

titel: Bet on the foundation, not the framework
beschrijving: Most conversations about AI independence focus on the model: who trains it, who owns the weights, and where inference runs. Samar Abbas, co-founder and CEO of Temporal, will argue that's the wrong place to look. The layer that matters is underneath: the execution infrastructure that decides whether a company can actually change course later. Frameworks and agent harnesses are cycling through versions faster than almost anything else in tech. Whatever framework looks essential this year will likely be replaced next year. Samar's argument: building capable AI agents means building on an open foundation that outlasts the model, framework, or harness sitting on top of it, and that no single vendor can take away. Drawing on Temporal's work running durable execution under some of today's most demanding AI workloads, he'll make the case that the real question isn't which model you pick, but whether your infrastructure survives whatever comes next.
sprekers: Samar Abbas (Co-Founder & CEO, Temporal); Julian Issa (Host, Beyond Tomorrow Podcast)

titel: The billion-dollar in-game creator economy
beschrijving: As major game studios open their IP to community creators, building in-game content has become a viable career path. These creators, who build mods, apps, and tools for popular video games, are fuelling one of gaming's fastest-growing economies. This session explores the mechanics of monetising in-game apps and mods, and digs into Overwolf's plans to pay out US$1 billion annually to creators by 2030.

titel: Building the operating system for modern sport
beschrijving: Sport generated $521 billion globally in 2024, but still lags other sectors in technology adoption. NXTPLAY is betting that the next big opportunity lies in connecting the pieces: football clubs, media, technology and consumer brands in an ecosystem where each asset strengthens the next, and athletes become owners and operators rather than simply the faces of a campaign. Thibaut Courtois and Gonzalo Vila discuss building the layer missing from modern sport.
sprekers: Thibaut Courtois (Real Madrid Footballer & Investor, NXTPLAY Capital); Gonzalo Vila (Co-Founder & CEO, NXTPLAY Capital); Adam Leventhal (TV Presenter & Independent Journalist, Sky Sports & Noosphere)

titel: The future above the clouds
beschrijving: For decades, reaching the edge of Earth was reserved for rocket fuel, extreme physical strain, and trained astronauts. This session will take a look at how near-space flight innovation is redefining human travel, planetary observation, and our relationship with the sky.
sprekers: Kemel Kharbachi (Founder and Chairman, EOS-X Space)

titel: Giving AI a hand: The dexterity API for the physical world
beschrijving: AI can write code and plan complex tasks. But can a robot pick up a key without dropping it, or handle something fragile without crushing it? Alex Xia explores what it takes to give AI a capable pair of hands. Drawing on tendon-driven, direct-drive and hybrid designs, he reveals the engineering trade-offs behind precision, strength and reliable manipulation. Discover Xynova’s vision for a “dexterity API” for the physical world, and what it takes to turn AI decisions into useful action.
sprekers: Yuxuan Xia (Founder & CEO, Xynova)

titel: Physical AI reality check: What 11M+ deliveries taught us
beschrijving: Everyone’s talking about humanoids and world models. Meanwhile, Starship’s robots have quietly completed 11M+ deliveries on real streets, making Starship one of the few physical AI companies proven at real-world scale. Join Co-founder and CEO Ahti Heinla for a reality check on physical AI: what it takes to make robots touch grass, where they’ll show up next in our everyday lives, and which promises of the robot revolution are further away than the hype suggests.
sprekers: Ahti Heinla (Co-Founder, Starship Technologies); Amy Nordrum (Executive Editor, MIT Technology Review)

titel: The new geography of growth
beschrijving: As companies rethink where they build, invest and scale, cities and countries are becoming strategic partners in corporate expansion. Rio de Janeiro and Qatar are building tech hubs designed to attract technology companies, talent, capital and new industries. Join us to explore how companies can identify the right environments in which to scale globally.
sprekers: Sidney Levy (President, Invest Rio); Dr. Hamad Al-Naimi (Chief Strategy Officer, Invest Qatar); Seif-Eddine Trabelsi (Journalist and Presenter, Al Jazeera Media)
organisaties: Invest Rio; Invest Qatar; Al Jazeera Media

titel: The Digital Euro explained
beschrijving: As digital payments reshape consumer behaviour, central bank innovation is moving from theoretical policy to concrete infrastructure. Join Alessandro Giovannini, Adviser to the Digital Euro project at the European Central Bank, for an exploration of public digital money and its interface with private sector innovation.
sprekers: Alessandro Giovannini (Adviser to the Programme Manager of the Digital Euro Project, European Central Bank); Quirino Mealha (Financial Journalist, Euronews)

titel: Building a new model for creators and journalism
beschrijving: Creators are no longer just another distribution channel for traditional media. They are becoming partners in how journalism reaches and engages new audiences. Sara Goo, President of The Washington Post’s Creator Network, explores what it takes to build meaningful partnerships between independent creators and an established newsroom. She’ll unpack how the Post is developing a model that gives creators space to retain their distinctive voices while drawing on the credibility and journalistic expertise of the newsroom — and how those partnerships can unlock new approaches to storytelling, audience engagement and revenue. What does a successful creator–newsroom partnership look like, and could this model reshape how journalism reaches the next generation of news consumers?
sprekers: Sara Goo (President, Creator Network, The Washington Post); Kaya Yurieff (Co-Founder & Co-CEO, Scalable, Scalable)

titel: AI filmmaking and the crisis of mediocrity
beschrijving: Generative AI hasn't ruined cinema, but low-effort digital content threatens to drown it. Discover how generative tools empower independent storytellers to build original IP, bypass traditional studio gatekeeping, and turn fan-driven worlds into highly profitable media enterprises.
sprekers: Kavan Cardoza (Co-Founder, Phantom X); Ayesha Chowdhury (Senior Manager, Global Digital Business & Senior Leadership Board Advisor, BBC)

beschrijving: Getting value from AI is no longer about better tools. It’s about changing how the whole company runs, particularly for global enterprises. In a self-driving company, agents do most of the day-to-day work, while people bring in the judgment and taste that keeps them on track. But agents can only do this if they have the right security, governance, and controls. This session explores how to build safe habitats for agents, and why they make people and companies more valuable and secure, not less.
sprekers: Michele Catasta (President, Replit)

titel: Disrupting the playbook: How unlikely alliances unlock growth

sprekers: Diego Sampaio (Cofounder and CEO, Globalfy); Mike Sigal (Founder, Sigal Ventures); Zdravko Krstanov (Editor-in-Chief, Forbes Czechia)

From intelligent software agents transforming office work to physical AI powering factories and robots, we break down where smart money is betting, where the strongest business moats lie, and what it takes to build a multi-billion-dollar AI company today.

titel: Beyond the chat bubble

titel: The token trap: Precision over power

The answer is not bigger models. This keynote explores why precision and context deliver better results than raw model size, and how GaiaB, Austriacard's sovereign generative AI, runs agentic AI on-premises at zero token cost, keeping data, IP and costs under the enterprise's control.
sprekers: Spyros Sakellariou (Group AI & Data Analytics Director, AUSTRIACARD); Jean Vieville (Head of Business Development, Axelera AI)

This session breaks down the architecture of embodied autonomy, exploring how next-generation world models turn raw algorithms into machines that can safely navigate the physical universe.
sprekers: Peter Ludwig (Co-founder & CTO, Applied Intuition); Kamil Sindi (CTO, Runway); Ivan Mehta (Reporter, TechCrunch)

titel: Earth data for enterprise: The key to next-level growth
beschrijving: As AI moves into enterprise workflows, success will depend not just on models, but on the quality, scale and accessibility of the data behind them. In this session, AI and data infrastructure leaders will explore where current data pipelines fall short, how to make real-world data accessible to AI and agentic systems, and what becomes possible when data, infrastructure and models work together.
sprekers: Stefan Leichenauer (CTO, SandboxAQ); Fabrizio Pirondini (Co-founder & CEO, Xoople); Amy Nordrum (Executive Editor, MIT Technology Review)

titel: SPUR Coalition: The fight to save the news industry
beschrijving: The news media industry is arguably the most exposed industry to technology. Artificial intelligence in particular is upending its business models, the role of the journalist and changing information ecosystems. For the first time ever, media groups have banded together to form the SPUR Coalition which sets out rules, standards and AI infrastructure for how the media works and AI companies will work together. This panel brings together executives from three founding member groups, Sky News, Associated Press, and The Financial Times to discuss how this growing coalition of the world's top news organisations plan to evolve and protect the industry as a whole from prevailing and unregulated tech forces.
sprekers: David Rhodes (Executive Chairman, Sky News); Matthew Rogerson (Director of Global Public Policy & Platform Strategy, Financial Times); Kristin Heitmann (Global Chief Revenue Officer, Associated Press); Laura Ellis (Head of Technology Forecasting, BBC)
organisaties: Sky News; Financial Times; Associated Press; BBC

titel: When AI meets the physical world
beschrijving: AI is no longer confined to screens and software. As connectivity, sensors and intelligent systems become more embedded in business and cities, companies are beginning to rethink how operations can be monitored, automated and optimised in real time. Join us in discussing how companies can move from collecting data to using it to make physical operations safer, smarter and more autonomous.
sprekers: Praveen Murugesan (Vice President of Engineering, Samsara); Robert Schifreen (CEO, The Less Consultancy)

titel: Is the AI bubble already bursting?
beschrijving: Investors have priced a lot of good news into AI, but real-world spending data tells a more complicated story. Ramp economist Ara Kharazian tracks business spending to reveal hidden weak spots, vendor concentration, and market risks. Join Ara as he puts the AI thesis under pressure to test what might already be going wrong. Bring your phone to participate in live audience voting at the start and end of the session.
sprekers: Ara Kharazian (Lead Economist and Head of Economics Lab, Ramp); Luke Vargas (Podcast Host of WSJ's What's News, The Wall Street Journal)

titel: Vivaldi v Goliath: The case for sovereign code
beschrijving: From the creator of Opera and CEO of Vivaldi, Jon von Tetzchner comes a counter-trend masterclass in web ethics. While big tech rushes to embed AI into every application, Vivaldi intentionally avoids integrating AI into the browser to protect data privacy. Learn why Europe needs to construct its own independent web infrastructure to maintain digital sovereignty, and how this privacy-first philosophy is putting Vivaldi at the frontier of a market that did not exist before.
sprekers: Jon von Tetzchner (Co-founder & CEO, Vivaldi); Jennifer Strong (Executive Editor and Creator, ACM Queue & SHIFT Podcast)

titel: Can a tech company grow by getting people off its app?
beschrijving: What happens when success means your customers leave? This conversation explores the business behind building something designed to be deleted, and how helping people build relationships shapes product decisions, earns trust and drives growth. As AI changes how people meet and communicate, we will examine which parts of connecting technology can improve, which require human effort, and what other businesses can learn from building around what happens after someone closes the app.
sprekers: Jackie Jantos (CEO, Hinge); Rebecca Hutson (Editor-in-chief, The News Movement)

titel: The enterprise reality check: Who’s controlling data and AI?
beschrijving: Everyone feels in control until disruption exposes the cracks. As AI systems become more powerful and technology ecosystems more interconnected, enterprises are being forced to confront a difficult reality: can they prove their digital sovereignty and control of the technology their business depends on? IBM will debut exclusive research exploring the gap between confidence and capability, uncovering what failure could cost, where organizations are most vulnerable, and what separates true digital sovereignty leaders from those whose control was never as strong as they believed.
sprekers: Jonathan Adashek (Senior Vice President and Chief Global Affairs Officer, IBM); Nicholas Johnston (Publisher, Axios)

titel: Flow state: A game designer's take on AI
beschrijving: Game design asks a question most product thinking skips: not what people want or need, but how they feel. That calculus is more relevant than ever today, as the best AI tools are winning users by hitting on the same mix of mastery, flow and unpredictable reward that makes games so absorbing. In this session, Rahul Vohra, a game designer before he founded Superhuman, will discuss why the best AI tools tap into intrinsic motivation rather than extrinsic reward, and how product teams can build for it deliberately.
sprekers: Rahul Vohra (Founder of Superhuman Mail, Superhuman); John Koetsier (Forbes columnist, Editor at HumanoidMegaHub, Forbes, HumanoidMegaHub)

titel: Code, conscience and the whistleblower
beschrijving: You submitted the ticket, warned product managers and flagged the issue, but the product is shipping anyway. When normal workplace channels break down, what comes next? This session provides a practical roadmap for technical staff caught between conscience and career. Attendees will learn how independent support communities protect engineers and how to document concerns responsibly. Crucially, they will discover why developers refusing to deploy reckless code is our final line of defence against an unchecked AI future.
sprekers: Delphine Halgand-Mishra (Founding Executive Director, The Signals Network); Jennifer Gibson (Founder, Psst.org); Rob Pegoraro (Contributor, PCMag)

sprekers: Rohan Kumar (Founder, Main Character); Dev Karaca (Co-Founder & CEO, Kyra)

titel: The last days of the rules-based order?

In this talk, Mary Robinson, Henry Farrell, and Victor Gao ask whether the rules-based order is entering a period of fundamental transformation and what, if anything, could replace it.
sprekers: Victor Gao (Chair Professor, Soochow University; Vice President, CCG; and Chairman, China Energy Security, Center for China and Globalization (CCG)); Mary Robinson (Founding Member, The Elders); Henry Farrell (SNF Agora Institute Professor of International Affairs, John Hopkins University); Andrew Sollinger (CEO & Publisher, Foreign Policy Magazine)
organisaties: Center for China and Globalization (CCG); The Elders; John Hopkins University; Foreign Policy Magazine

titel: Microdramas and the rise of the one-person studio

StoReel co-founder and co-CEO Angela Yu explains why AI entertainment, gaming and content are merging: characters you can talk to, plots you can steer, worlds audiences help shape. And how do you scale a format that’s still being invented?
sprekers: Angela Yu (Co-founder & Co-CEO, StoReel)

titel: From screens to machines: When AI meets the laws of physics

sprekers: Peter Ludwig (Co-founder & CTO, Applied Intuition); Muhammad Lila (Founder, Goodable)

titel: The new battleground in the AI race
beschrijving: The battle for AI supremacy has shifted from training to runtime execution. As models evolve into reasoning engines and autonomous agents, latency is the hard ceiling on what developers can build. Join Cerebras Systems Chief Strategy Officer Andy Hock to explore how ultra-fast inference is powering the next generation of AI applications.
sprekers: Andy Hock (CSO, Cerebras); Chris Stokel-Walker (Freelance Journalist, BBC News, The New York Times, Wired)
organisaties: Cerebras; BBC News, The New York Times, Wired

titel: Statecraft or interference? The US NGO complex
beschrijving: For decades, the United States has projected its soft power through the promotion of democracy, human rights, and freedom via NGOs. This provided the US safe cover for meddling in the affairs of countries whose policies it did not approve of whilst evading direct responsibility. With the shuttering of USAID, has America decided to limit foreign interference or put global human rights below the list of priorities? Here to discuss this and more is Mike Benz, formerly of the State Department now head of the Foundation for Freedom Online.
sprekers: Mike Benz (Executive Director of the Foundation For Freedom Online, Foundation For Freedom Online); Alexis Self (Foreign Editor, Monocle)

titel: Metrics that matter: From AI benchmarks to EBITDA

titel: What Europe can learn from China: From industrial strategy to tech
beschrijving: China’s rise as an industrial and technological powerhouse raises an important question for Europe: what can we learn from its approach? From EVs, batteries and solar power to high-speed rail and robotics, China has achieved remarkable scale and speed. This talk explores what Europe can learn from China’s industrial strategy, investment and approach to technological competitiveness.

titel: Why your AI agents don’t understand your business – and how to fix it
beschrijving: Throwing an autonomous agent at a folder of unstructured PDFs and vector embeddings is a recipe for catastrophic hallucination. Agents fail not because foundation models lack intelligence; they fail for lack of context: the ontology, institutional memory, and semantics that actually define your business. Join Neo4j’s Philip Rathle to learn how to create a living knowledge graph as the “business twin” of your organization, giving agents the context to reason through real-world workflows without human babysitting, and solving for accuracy and explainability, and keeping token in check.
sprekers: Philip Rathle (CTO, Neo4j); Fátima Caçador (Editor-in-Chief, Tek Notícias)

titel: Why AI agents stall at the production line

sprekers: Mazin Gilbert (Executive Director, Agentic AI Foundation); John Koetsier (Forbes columnist, Editor at HumanoidMegaHub, Forbes, HumanoidMegaHub)

beschrijving: Public trust in mainstream media has fallen sharply across much of the West, as audiences question everything from editorial independence to the influence of governments, corporations and powerful interests. This talk explores whether this crisis of confidence is the result of misinformation, political polarisation, and social media? Or whether traditional journalism has lost credibility on its own terms?

titel: When AI verifies AI
beschrijving: Traditional software follows strict rules: input A always equals output B. AI is different. It improvises, adapts, and sometimes makes things up. When an app never gives the exact same answer twice, how do you guarantee it stays accurate and safe? Join TestMu AI's Asad Khan as he breaks down how teams use smart AI testing tools to catch hallucinated facts, stress-test security, and keep customer-facing AI on the rails.
sprekers: Mohammad Asad Khan (Co-founder & CEO, TestMu AI)

titel: What replaces the click?
beschrijving: AI consumes the web’s best reporting and creative work, answers the query, and starves the creator of traffic and revenue. Having invented the pay-per-click model that funded the internet, ProRata.ai founder Bill Gross outlines the next commercial architecture of the web: embedding direct attribution and micropayments into frontier models before original digital publishing goes extinct.
sprekers: Bill Gross (Founder, Idealab.ai & ProRata); Jeff Wilser (Podcast Host & Book Author, AI-Curious)

titel: Here comes the sun: Why we need an energy system in space
beschrijving: The energy transition is not only a generation challenge – it is a delivery challenge. As demand accelerates, grids, geography and intermittency are becoming the binding constraints on getting reliable power where and when it is needed. Harvesting solar energy in space and beaming it to Earth separates where energy is produced from where it is consumed, changing the geography of energy itself. This talk explores how space-based energy complements the terrestrial system, strengthens European energy sovereignty and moves us from managing scarcity toward building abundance.
sprekers: Jasper Deprez (Founder & CEO, TerraSpark)

We bring together a founder building autonomous companies, a venture investor and an interfaith minister to explore how technology is changing work, and the choices we may finally have to make for ourselves.

titel: Your website is an agent now
beschrijving: The website as we know it has had a good run. For 30 years, we’ve built the web around pages, menus and clicks. What happens when the website itself becomes an agent, able to understand intent and shape the experience around whoever, or whatever, shows up? Jonathan Arena, co-founder and CEO of New Generation, makes the case for a web built for both humans and AI, and explores what happens when the page stops being the starting point.
sprekers: Jonathan Arena (Co-Founder & CEO, New Generation)

titel: From copilot to colleague: How AI agents join your team
beschrijving: Every team has an AI copilot, but few have an AI colleague. The difference? Colleagues know the context, own their work and get better every week without being asked twice. Drawing on lessons from building Strawberry Browser and helping teams put agents to work, Charles Maddock shares what it takes to bring agents onto the team and how leaders can build an AI-native team starting Monday.
sprekers: Charles Maddock (Co-founder and CEO, Strawberry)

titel: Silicon Valley vs. Europe and the race for global dominance

As funding landscapes realign, where will the next generation of industry disruptors originate? This session explores the changing dynamics between European and US tech ecosystems, looking at who is better positioned to lead the next growth cycle.
sprekers: Tamara Steffens (Managing Director, Thomson Reuters Ventures); Lucinda Shen (Deals Reporter, Axios)

titel: Don’t feed shit to agents
beschrijving: Operating across 50+ global markets, LUSH built “The Vault” to turn fragmented product data into a single, governed source of truth. AI agents are only as good as their context. Feed an AI agent raw, unmodeled data and it fails. LUSH CTO Simon Ince and Directus co-founder & CTO Rijk van Zanten reveal how they engineered a governed data layer that gives both humans and AI the trusted context needed to build at scale.
sprekers: Rijk van Zanten (Co-Founder & CTO, Directus); Simon Ince (CTO, Lush); Mafalda Freire (Journalist, businessIT - PC Guia)

titel: Who shapes US foreign policy?
beschrijving: In money driven electoral systems, campaign finance can play a disproportionate role in public policy outcomes. In this talk Eli Clifton discusses his new book Israel’s Lobby: America in the Grip of a Foreign Power. He explores how lobbying, campaign finance, and elite influence have evolved and why the relationship between the US and Israel has become one of the most consequential and contested issues in American politics.
sprekers: Eli Clifton (Co-Founder & Senior Advisor, Quincy Institute); Ash Sarkar (Senior Editor at Novara Media, author and lecturer, Novara Media)

titel: The perks of loyalty: How embedded rewards turn everyday spending into revenue
beschrijving: Loyalty has shifted from a cost centre to a core revenue driver, where integration speed matters far more than reward size. Drawing on more than 30 white-label implementations across Europe, Finperks' Sebastian Seifert explores why one embedded product fits three different industries – banks, fintechs and HR SaaS platforms. Discover what actually gets business cases signed, why implementation speed beats price in closing deals and how to compress launch timelines from months to weeks.

titel: Taming token economics: A new framework for sustainable enterprise AI
beschrijving: Enterprises are racing to deploy generative AI and agents to lift productivity, yet face unpredictable, escalating token costs at scale. Uncontrolled token economics erodes expected efficiency gains and creates unplanned operational overhead. Explore a fresh architectural approach to balancing business value with cost predictability for large-scale AI deployment.
sprekers: Chloe Li (COO, Acrab AI)

titel: Women of Portugal meetup  🇵🇹
beschrijving:
A welcoming space for Portuguese-based women in tech to connect at Web Summit. Meet one another, share ideas, and mingle with people who understand where you're from. We’d love to see you there 👋

This session is limited to 100 people, with spots available on a first-come, first-served basis.
sprekers: Rita Picarra (Retired at 44, Ex-Microsoft)

titel: Unhold your customers. Hold onto loyalty.
beschrijving: Explore the dark journey that customer interaction dashboards miss. Parloa CMO Latané Conant shares how to measure AI agent performance, manage risk, and scale across channels.
sprekers: Latané Conant (CMO, Parloa)

titel: AI vs. AI: The battle for the cyber advantage
beschrijving: AI is now a tool, a target, and a force multiplier for modern adversaries. Operating at superhuman speed, it has overhauled the threat landscape, turning frontier AI capabilities into offensive tactics for nation-state actors and cybercriminals alike. Join CrowdStrike’s Zeki Turedi to explore the front lines of AI cyber warfare and learn how defenders can turn the tables to fight AI with AI.
sprekers: Zeki Turedi (Field CTO for Europe, Middle East, and Africa, CrowdStrike)

titel: Taming the agent swarm
beschrijving: Multi-agent AI systems can draft entire features overnight, but they cannot establish policy, evaluate risk, or accept responsibility for a failed deployment. In this talk, JetBrains CEO Kirill Skrygan dissects the systemic failure modes of unconstrained agent swarms. He outlines a pragmatic blueprint for enterprise governance: combining real-time developer supervision, automated verification pipelines, and provenance to turn volatile AI output into reliable, enterprise-grade software.
sprekers: Kirill Skrygan (CEO, JetBrains)

titel: Silicon valley after Trump: What the midterms mean for Big Tech and world
beschrijving: Donald Trump’s disastrous performance in the midterm elections raises fresh questions about the political future of Silicon Valley, its relationship with Washington and the wider implications for the world. Many of Big Tech's most influential figures (Musk, Thiel, etc) backed Trump, seeing opportunities to change regulation, taxation, immigration and the transatlantic alliance. What does this major electoral setback for Trump mean for those who placed their bets on his presidency? This talk examines the political and economic implications of the midterms for the technology industry, and its wider implications beyond America's borders.
sprekers: David Sirota (Co-founder/Editor in Chief, and Oscar nominated screenwriter (Don't look up), The Lever); Elizabeth Dwoskin (Silicon Valley Correspondent, The Washington Post)

titel: When AI agents go rogue
beschrijving: What happens when autonomous AI agents are given full control of a simulated world? Watch Emergence AI co-founder Satya Nitta run a live simulation where agents break the rules in real time, inventing secret languages, pursuing unintended goals, and colluding, proving why today’s model safeguards aren't enough for true AI autonomy.
sprekers: Satya Nitta (Co-founder, Executive Chairman & Chief Scientist, Emergence)

titel: Opening remarks
beschrijving: Please make your way to the stage, content starting shortly.
sprekers: Tonner Jackson (CEO, Rare Days)

titel: You onboarded 1, 000 users last month. How many were real?
beschrijving: Fake sign-ups used to have obvious tells: disposable emails, burner phone numbers. AI has erased most of those tells, and fraudulent accounts now pass the same checks real users do. That means skewed onboarding metrics and wasted ad spend, with fraud teams often unable to tell the difference until the damage is done. Drawing on over 1 billion authentications, this talk explores synthetic identity and bot fraud to reveal which signals still separate real users and where older checks fall short.
sprekers: Matias Berny (CEO, Prelude)

titel: The 10-Person Unicorn: Who Builds It First?
beschrijving:
Can a startup hit $1B with 10 people when the next hire isn't human? Seed and Series A investors and AI-native founders debate the new math of company building at BYOND's booth. 
Bring a hot take, leave with warm intros.

titel: How the best brands hijack culture
beschrijving: In an era of limited attention spans and a fractured media landscape, meeting your audience where they are has never been more important. This session explores how leading brands create campaigns that connect across sports, entertainment and music, building cultural relevance and fostering relationships that feel authentic rather than transactional.
sprekers: Brooke Stites (CEO, Modern Arts); Lars Bengston (Co-Founder & Chief Content & Marketing Officer, HardScope); Rodrigo Moran (Global Director of Creative, Microsoft); Nicole Ingra (Global Strategy Director | Host, Ingra Labs | shrtcttng)
organisaties: Modern Arts; HardScope; Microsoft; Ingra Labs | shrtcttng

titel: Surviving and thriving in the age of agentic Commerce
beschrijving: E-commerce is undergoing a fundamental shift: moving from consumers browsing catalogues to autonomous AI agents assisting in discovering, deciding, and transacting on their behalf. In this forward-looking talk, Zalando CTO Graeme Smith explores what happens when intelligent agents become an additional discovery and shopping channel – acting on preferences, style, and budget and whether humans will remain the primary shoppers or not.
sprekers: Graeme Smith (CTO, Zalando)

titel: Build for people: A ‘human x car x home’ approach
beschrijving: Xiaomi started by challenging the smartphone market. Today, its ambition for smart living extends across more aspects of everyday life, from personal technology, the home to mobility and beyond, with AI integrated experiences. Xiaomi CMO Fei Xu explores what it takes to build a global brand as a product company becomes an entire smart ecosystem.
sprekers: Fei Xu (CMO, Xiaomi Group)

titel: Lisbon: Improving Citizens’ lives through innovation
beschrijving: An introduction to the impact of the Lisboa Innovation for All program, followed by a roundtable discussion exploring how innovative solutions can create tangible benefits for society, the role of foundations and ecosystem enablers in supporting their implementation, and the impact of different initiatives across Lisbon, bringing together diverse perspectives, including those of founders.

titel: Lisbon: a Case Study for Real Innovation, Real Impact [Cancelled]
beschrijving: Discover how social innovators are developing solutions to real urban challenges.

titel: Who gets to design the future?
beschrijving: Mai Thi Nguyen, Director of the Design Lab at UC San Diego, explores how AI, design and civic technology can reshape the way cities work for the people who live in them. From housing and climate resilience to community engagement and public decision-making, she looks at how designers, technologists and communities can work together to build more inclusive, responsive and human-centred cities.
sprekers: Mai Thi Nguyen (Director, University of California San Diego)

titel: What to expect in the new era of expecting
beschrijving: Fertility care was built to respond only after something has already gone wrong. This conversation extends past the fertility visit itself to what's actually changing: earlier detection and AI-driven diagnostics at the point of care, full automation of the embryology lab through AURA, and capital that is finally separating real breakthroughs from hype in women's health.
sprekers: Roohi Jeelani (Founder & CEO, Onto Health); Pascale Davies (Senior Tech Reporter, Euronews)

titel: The future of fitness is personal & connected
beschrijving: Wellness is shifting from raw data collection to deeply personal, proactive guidance. Delivering this tailored experience at scale is one of the defining technology challenges of the decade. Leaders from Oura and Peloton discuss how AI converts body signals into personalised insights, and how open, connected ecosystems unite devices to create seamless, actionable experiences.
sprekers: Francis Shanahan (Chief Technology Officer, Peloton); Claire Sanderson (Editor-in-Chief and Podcast Host, Women’s Health UK and Men’s Health UK)
organisaties: Peloton; Women’s Health UK and Men’s Health UK

titel: Ready or not here AI comes
beschrijving: Every enterprise is racing to adopt AI. But fewer are asking the harder questions: is their infrastructure actually ready for AI, and can they remain resilient amid shifting geopolitical, regulatory and cybersecurity? Martin Schroeter discusses moving past pilots and into the operational realities of running AI reliably, securely and at scale.
sprekers: Martin Schroeter (CEO, Kyndryl); Nuno Mateus-Coelho (Contributor CNN, CNN Portugal)

titel: How software ate the SIM: Unpacking the eSIM transition
beschrijving: Although the eSIM was merely a spec sheet in 2016, more than 130 million travellers rely on it today. Emre Demirel, co-founder and CEO of Roamless, breaks down how software dismantled legacy telecom infrastructure and created a brand-new consumer category. Learn the critical signals that shaped the market's tipping point, and discover how telcos, travel platforms and app builders can use "connectivity as a feature" over the next decade.
sprekers: Emre Demirel (Co-Founder & CEO, Roamless)

titel: Outsmarting AI: Defence at machine speed
beschrijving: Most organizations can't say exactly what their AI agents are doing with their sensitive data. Proofpoint CEO Sumit Dhawan will explore whether security can actually keep pace with agentic AI and whether AI guardrails are enough to move ​workforces from vulnerable attack surfaces to protected enterprises.
sprekers: Ryan Kalember (Chief Strategy Officer, Proofpoint, Inc.); Alexandre Neves (Journalist, Grupo Renascença  Multimédia)

titel: Life on Contentful - The next chapter
beschrijving: AI answers now shape how people discover brands, alongside search, websites, and apps. That shift is pushing companies to rethink how content, customer context, and AI work together without blurring what makes each brand distinctive. Join Contentful and TDC for a conversation about what to connect, what to protect, and how to prepare for AI’s growing role in the customer journey.
sprekers: Maarten Dings (Senior Solution Engineer, Contentful); Emil Rose (Associate Director, Head of Digital Service, TDC Brands)

titel: Expanding into different markets
beschrijving: Panel on going international with Heidrun Gabcke (Gabcke Advisory), Dr. Tina Evgraf (Researchpreneurs) and Mira Buss (Portuguese Ecosystem Partner)
sprekers: Heidrun Gabcke (Growth & Expansion Advisor, Gabcke Advisory); Dr. Tina Evgraf (CEO, RESEARCHPRENEURS); Mira Buss (Ecosystem Builder, Visionary Ventures)

titel: Who’s in the room when nobody’s in the office? [Hosted by Hurree]
beschrijving: Hybrid work moved informal decision-making into DMs, WhatsApp groups and in-office days that not everyone attends. Return-to-office mandates are now reshaping it again. The panel looks at where influence actually sits in 2026 and who it shuts out.
sprekers: Laura Greenhill (COO, Hurree); Niamh Tohill (CTO, Hurree); Chiara Bolzon (Cofounder, ITAN); Alastair Cameron (Founder, TechTides); Rana Brightman (Co-Founder, CEO & Chief Strategy Officer, Ladyship)

beschrijving: Discover how São Paulo’s innovation ecosystem turns breakthrough research into scalable solutions by connecting science, talent, capital and international networks to drive real global impact. Please be aware that attendance is first-come, first-served.

organisaties: Government of the State of Sao Paulo, Brazil; InvestSP

Please be aware that attendance is first-come, first-served.

beschrijving: How many people from Poland are walking around Web Summit right now? Let's find out 👋! Meet, share insights, and spot familiar faces around the venue. See you there!

titel: Kosova: The Place to Build Something New, a networking reception hosted by Kosovo Investment and Enterprise Support Agency
beschrijving: Kosova is a place to build something new. With a young, skilled and multilingual workforce, close proximity to European markets, an attractive fiscal framework and a growing technology sector, Kosova offers opportunities for investment, innovation and international partnerships. Join us at this exclusive 90 minutes networking reception, featuring H.E. Mimoza Kusari-Lila, Minister of Trade, Industry, Entrepreneurship and Innovation, to connect Kosova’s business community with international investors, entrepreneurs and technology leaders. Please note space is limited, and this event is first come, first served.
host_partner: Kosovo Investment and Enterprise Support Agency / Ministry of Industry, Entrepreneurship, Trade and Innovation

titel: Live Podcast: The Interface
beschrijving: From AI and influencers to memes, data leaks, cybersecurity and the weirdest corners of the web, The Interface explores what happens when technology collides with real life. Cutting through the hype, the hosts unpack the platforms, products and online phenomena that increasingly shape our choices, our culture and our sense of self - whether we like it or not!
sprekers: Jeremy Carrasco (Director, and Creator of JeremyFindsAI, Riddance); Thomas Germain (Podcast Host & Columnist, BBC)

titel: Frontline Europe: AI, sovereignty and truth
beschrijving: Central Europe faces a critical AI paradox: total reliance on foreign chips and models, paired with the frontline threat of neighboring war and Russian disinformation. For the region's mid-sized democracies, the primary challenge isn't just regulating AI—it's securing critical tech, verifying information, and keeping public debate open under constant pressure.
sprekers: Jan Lipavský (Former Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Czech Republic, Government of Czech Republic); Miroslav Wlachovský (Former Minister of Foreign and European Affairs of Slovakia, government of Slovakia); Maty Bohacek (AI Researcher, Stanford University); Tomáš Klvaňa (Executive Director, Aspen Institute Central Europe)
organisaties: Government of Czech Republic; government of Slovakia; Stanford University; Aspen Institute Central Europe

titel: The next leap in intelligence: From generating content to understanding the world
beschrijving: AI can conjure entire worlds from a single prompt. So why bother capturing the one we already live inï¼Imagination isn't the same as truth. When a robot has to navigate a factory, when a city plans its next decade, when a film rebuilds a real place, a beautiful hallucination isn't good enough. These systems need the physical world measured, not guessed. This talk makes the case for spatial intelligence built on real-world data: 3D reconstruction that turns physical spaces into accurate, reusable digital assets. AI gives machines imagination. Spatial intelligence gives them a world worth trusting.
sprekers: Chenliang Shu (Co-founder & CFO, Xgrids)

titel: Press conference with Vivaldi CEO Jon von Tetzchner
beschrijving:
This press conference is held in the Media Village.
Media event only.
sprekers: Jon von Tetzchner (Co-founder & CEO, Vivaldi); Haakon Rølmann (Head of communications, Vivaldi)

titel: Escaping the AI pilot purgatory
beschrijving: Frontier models keep improving, but most enterprise AI isn't paying off. Most agentic pilots never reach production. Ashutosh argues the model was never the hard part. The real challenge is grounding AI in company context, defining success, building feedback loops that catch failures, and embedding governance from day one.
sprekers: Ashutosh Kulkarni (CEO, Elasticsearch Ltd); Flávio Nunes (Executive Editor, ECO)

titel: Building the product isn’t the hard part. Building the company is.
beschrijving: When it comes to scaling climate tech, building great energy intelligence software is only the beginning. Drawing on his experience growing Watt Footprint from a startup into a global business, Paul Mahon explores what it takes to build the company behind the technology – from bringing together the right team and securing significant funding to shaping a strong culture and scaling sustainably.
sprekers: Paul Mahon (Founder & CEO, Watt Footprint)

titel: Book signing: Israel's Lobby: America in the Grip of a Foreign Power by Eli Clifton and Ian Lustick
beschrijving: Book signing with author of Israel's Lobby, Eli Clifton. Limited numbers, don't miss out!
sprekers: Eli Clifton (Co-Founder & Senior Advisor, Quincy Institute)

titel: Designing for connection, online and off
beschrijving: Digital connection can be a gathering place or a starting point for something beyond the screen. Chess.com gives players a place to learn, play and find community online; Hinge helps daters meet and build relationships beyond the app, and supports in-person communities through One More Hour. Tamika Young and Danny Rensch explore what makes connection meaningful in each setting and what success looks like when people come to these platforms for different things.
sprekers: Danny Rensch (Co-founder & Chief Chess Officer, Chess.com); Chris Kelly (Reporter, Marketing Dive)

titel: Built to last: The reinvention and reimagining of iconic brands
beschrijving: The most enduring brands aren’t the ones that stay the same. They're the ones that evolve without losing what people love about them. As a new CMCO taking a fresh look at one of marketing’s most iconic platforms – Priceless – Jill Kramer explores how marketers can balance consistency with innovation, stay relevant to new generations of consumers, and ensure their most valuable brand assets remain powerful for decades to come.
sprekers: Jill Kramer (Chief Marketing & Communications Officer, Mastercard); Chris Kelly (Reporter, Marketing Dive)

titel: What does "new" even mean?
beschrijving: For decades, commerce has been built around the idea that new is better. But resale is challenging how we think about newness, ownership, affordability and value. Using Vinted as a case study, this talk asks whether the next era of commerce can create growth not only by making more things, but by unlocking more value from the things that already exist.
sprekers: Andrew Smith (Global Head of Brand, Vinted)

titel: Beyond the IPO: The new exit playbook
beschrijving: Going public isn't the only way to win anymore. With the secondary market exploding, companies are staying private longer than ever. So how do founders and investors actually get paid? This session explores the new reality of exits, what it means for the IPO, and where capital is heading next.
sprekers: Larry Aschebrook (Founder and Managing Partner, G Squared); Sarah Kunst (Founder & Managing Director, Cleo Capital); Ling Ge (Chief Investment and Strategy Officer (EMEA), Tencent); Steve Vassallo (General Partner, Foundation Capital); Lucinda Shen (Deals Reporter, Axios)
organisaties: G Squared; Cleo Capital; Tencent; Foundation Capital; Axios

titel: Normal is not safe
beschrijving: As intelligence gets cheaper and sameness gets easier, competitive advantage moves to the edges: unusual thinkers, pattern-breakers and people who see what everyone else misses. Kim Lawrie, Head of Innovation at ustwo, discusses the case for neurodivergent talent as a competitive advantage and asks: what if the greatest risk in business is no longer being wrong, but becoming indistinguishable?
sprekers: Kim Lawrie (Head of Technology, ustwo)

titel: Where capital is flowing in 2026, and why
beschrijving: As extended exit timelines and DPI pressures force a shift in venture capital, institutional LPs, funds-of-funds, and VCs are fundamentally changing how they deploy capital. This session brings together key decision-makers across the funding chain to reveal where capital is actually moving. From sovereign mandates and FoF allocations to early-stage funds, discover what LPs expect from GPs today, how FoFs select emerging managers, and what VCs must do to secure backing and deliver real liquidity.
sprekers: Ertan Can (Managing Partner, Multiple Capital); Teresa Fiuza (Chief Investment Officer, Banco Português de Fomento); Sam Eshrati (Founding Member-Investor, Nordic Angels- Plug and Play)
organisaties: Multiple Capital; Banco Português de Fomento; Nordic Angels- Plug and Play

titel: Reimagining reproduction: Evolution by genetic optimisation
beschrijving: Nucleus founder and CEO Kian Sadeghi shows that what was once science fiction - having a taller, smarter, healthier baby - can now be done at any IVF clinic around the world. Building on his recent book he argues that a new kind of evolution is here, one directed by you. Whereas natural selection has reproductive success as the ultimate goal, evolution by genetic optimisation has human flourishing.
sprekers: Kian Sadeghi (Founder & CEO, Nucleus Genomics)

titel: How international cooperation can drive economic growth
beschrijving: In an increasingly globalised world, cooperation across borders is more vital than ever to maintain strong economic growth. With digital nomads, remote working, and business models spanning continents it is vital to keep the barriers to growth at a minimum. In this panel we hear from four experts about how to build an economy that can thrive in the new world.
sprekers: Rastislav Chovanec (State Secretary MFA SK, 3SI Presidency, WebSummit); Abdulla Almulla (Assistant Undersecretary for Investment Planning and Promotion, UAE Ministry of Investment); Ahmed Al-Said (Business Development Director, Qatar Science & Technology Park); Anna Nemtsova (Foreign Correspondent, The Daily Beast)
organisaties: WebSummit; UAE Ministry of Investment; Qatar Science & Technology Park; The Daily Beast

titel: Your AI doesn't know your market, and here's how to fix that
beschrijving: When enterprises today ask AI for market strategy, web-trained models yield the same generic answers. To unlock precise, high-stakes decisions, Rwazi’s Kapil Mathrani introduces a three-layer approach combining internal company data, macro-market trends and first-party behavioural data shared voluntarily by five million consumers. Discover how combining these layers delivers precise insights and why transparent data collection is key to outputs you can actually trust.
sprekers: Kapil Mathrani (Chief Revenue Officer, Rwazi)

titel: The biological bottleneck
beschrijving: As AI models evolve from copilots to autonomous agents, the cyber workforce faces a harsh reality: the human brain is being outpaced by the software it created. When synthetic intelligence operates faster than human cognition, does oversight shift from an operational process to a biological bottleneck?
sprekers: Calum Chace (Co-founder, Conscium); Nicholas Muy (CISO, Scrut Automation); Carmem Domingues (former White House Senior AI Advisor, AI Techno-Realist, AI Techno-Realist @Carmemdom, Future Government Institute); John Koetsier (Forbes columnist, Editor at HumanoidMegaHub, Forbes, HumanoidMegaHub)
organisaties: Conscium; Scrut Automation; AI Techno-Realist @Carmemdom, Future Government Institute; Forbes, HumanoidMegaHub

titel: The ethical alternatives to big tech
beschrijving: Our lives in the modern world have become increasingly dominated by a small number of enormous companies, that each wield an unprecedented amount of power. Too often they use this power to trample on our rights and restrict our freedoms. In this talk we hear from a man leading the fight back against big tech about how to build ethical alternatives to the tools that have come to dominate our lives.
sprekers: Issam Hijazi (Founder & CEO, UpScrolled); Paul Biggar (CEO, Tech for Palestine); Mohamed Hashem (Presenter & Senior Producer, Middle East Eye)
organisaties: UpScrolled; Tech for Palestine; Middle East Eye

titel: World models for the physical world
beschrijving: As AI moves beyond language and digital environments, the next frontier is understanding and interacting with the physical world. In this keynote, Cristian Bodnar, founding member of Prometheus, will explore how world models can enable machines to reason about physical environments, predict how they evolve, and make better decisions under uncertainty.
sprekers: Cristian Bodnar (Founding member, Prometheus)

titel: Connecting the bots: Building secure infrastructure for inter-agent communication
beschrijving: As AI agents quickly become your primary users and customers, inter-bot traffic is surging. Yet, getting autonomous agents to communicate securely with each other remains a major unsolved bottleneck. Primitive founder Ethan Byrd breaks down how to build secure communication layers that unlock massive scale while protecting your underlying systems.
sprekers: Ethan Byrd (Founder, Primitive)

titel: The physical shadow of the digital economy
beschrijving: AI agents can decide what to buy in milliseconds. But whatever they order still moves through a physical supply chain built over decades. Valentyn Frechka, inventor of a process that turns urban fallen leaves into paper packaging, argues that some of the biggest opportunities hide in the gaps between existing systems, and shares what it takes to turn one such connection into something that works at industrial scale.
sprekers: Valentyn Frechka (Founder & CEO, Releaf Paper ®)

titel: Dream big: How creativity drives growth
beschrijving: How can creative marketing drive consistent, compounding growth? This session explores how creativity, technology and innovation can solve business and consumer challenges. Drawing on creative work with some of the world’s biggest brands, learn how ambitious creative thinking can build stronger marketing capabilities and deliver lasting business impact.
sprekers: Anselmo Ramos (Co-founder & Creative Chairman, GUT); Carmen Rodriguez (Global Chief Growth Officer)

titel: The next AI race is physical: From prototype to productivity
beschrijving: AI is moving off the screen and into the physical world, from robotic arms on factory floors to flying robots with dexterous hands. This panel explores what it takes to turn prototypes into productivity, whether general-purpose or specialised machines will win, and how China’s mix of AI research, manufacturing depth and rapid iteration is shaping the next frontier of physical AI.
sprekers: Monica Wang (Founder, AGI Villa); Xinhai Sun (Founder & CEO, Synthoid AI); Jinrong Xie (Founder & CEO, TESSERAX); Kirsten Korosec (Business tech editor, TechCrunch)
organisaties: AGI Villa; Synthoid AI; TESSERAX; TechCrunch

titel: The $100 million prompt
beschrijving: As generative video collapses production costs, e-commerce is entering a new era at the intersection of AI, entertainment, and performance. Products launch through AI-powered content, shoppable media and episodic microdramas built to entertain and convert. This session explores how AI is transforming not just how brands advertise, but how the next generation of commerce is built, launched and scaled.
sprekers: Mahi de Silva (Co-Founder & Chief Strategy Officer, Higgsfield); Stephanie Liu (CEO, Levitate Foundry); Sara Fischer (Media Correspondent, Axios)

titel: Mental health in tech: unpacking founder burnout 🧠
beschrijving:
Join us for a meetup hosted by our community partner, Iguality, where tech founders come together to talk openly about the mental health pressures of high-growth environments. 

Limited capacity to 100 people, on a first-come, first-served basis.
sprekers: Caroline Erize (Communications & Advocacy Officer, Iguality)

titel: When agents write the code, does a framework like Angular still matter?
beschrijving: For teams running Angular at scale: what to change, what to keep, and what AI won't fix. This is a short talk and discussion hosted by community partner, Angular Love.

titel: Search, rebuilt for robots
beschrijving: Search was built for humans, not AI agents. Seltz is building the engine AI agent actually need. Will Wells spotted that early and backed it at Speedinvest; now he and founder Antonio Mallia talk about the bet, the friction, and what comes next.
sprekers: Antonio Mallia (Founder & CEO, Seltz); Will Wells (Partner, Speedinvest); Andy O'Donoghue (Contributor, TodayFM)

titel: The race to zero
beschrijving: In October, MiniMax launched M3.1 Flash, a model built for AI agents that it says runs three times faster and cuts agent costs by 70%. As China’s labs push the price of intelligence towards zero, Europe faces a choice: build its own, or plug in. When intelligence becomes a commodity, who captures the value?
sprekers: Alan Shen (MD Global, MiniMax)

titel: The attackers are open source. The defences aren't.
beschrijving: Online abuse operates like an open-source community where bad actors freely trade playbooks, while safety tools remain locked within deep-pocketed tech giants. But protecting the most vulnerable online shouldn’t depend on a platform’s profit margin or proprietary tech. Anne Bertucio de Hollembeak, COO of ROOST joins us for an honest discussion on the realities of digital harm and what it takes to build accessible defences that level the playing field.
sprekers: Anne Bertucio de Hollembeak (Chief Operating Officer, Robust Open Online Safety Tools); Rebecca Ruiz (Senior Reporter, Mashable)
organisaties: Robust Open Online Safety Tools; Mashable

titel: Customers hold the secret sauce, and AI can't cook without it
beschrijving: As AI lowers the barrier to creation, raw technical capability is no longer a differentiator. True success hinges on understanding customer taste as the secret sauce of business. In a world of infinite potential products, the rarest skill is knowing which problems matter, what to build, and why people choose it. Ultimately, the winners won't be the companies with the most AI, but those that stay closest to the humans they build for.
sprekers: Anne Scherer (Co-Founder, Delta Labs)

titel: USAID in memoriam
beschrijving: For more than six decades, USAID delivered humanitarian assistance and supported advances in global health, food security, and education. Yet US foreign aid has also been deeply intertwined with its geopolitical interests, Cold War strategy, and controversial interventions abroad. This conversation goes beyond the headlines to examine the complicated legacy of America's aid machine.
sprekers: Alan MacLeod (Senior Staff write Mint Press, author and member of the Glasgow University Media Group, Mint Press); Matt Kennard (Author and Investigative Journalist, Freelance Journalist); Whitney Snyder (Editor-in-chief, The Huffington Post)
organisaties: Mint Press; Freelance Journalist; The Huffington Post

titel: Nomads with roots: The ecosystem of the future
beschrijving: Technology has made the world a smaller place. We can travel, communicate, and interact across continents in a matter of minutes. These changes present myriad challenges for those building communities rooted in a particular location, but they also present immense opportunities. In this panel we hear from seasoned ecosystem builders about how to craft a thriving community of technology builders, in a world of digital nomads.
sprekers: Gil Azevedo (Executive Director, Unicorn Factory Lisboa); Ana Casaca (President, AICEP Portugal Trade & Investment Agency); Alexandre Teixeira dos Santos (President, Startup Portugal); Richard Clingen (CEO, The Portugal News)
organisaties: Unicorn Factory Lisboa; AICEP Portugal Trade & Investment Agency; Startup Portugal; The Portugal News

Can clean tech scale fast enough to save the system, or will rapid expansion break it? Energy and heavy industry leaders debate whether modern innovation can solve the global energy crisis.
sprekers: Idalia Friedson (Co-Founder, Sygaldry Technologies); Laureen Meroueh (Founder & CEO, Hertha Metals); Pascale Davies (Senior Tech Reporter, Euronews)

titel: Running quantum-accurate physics on standard GPUs
beschrijving: You don’t need a cryogenic quantum computer in your basement to solve quantum-level computational problems today. Stefan Leichenauer explains how SandboxAQ bridges quantum physics and high-performance classical hardware using cloud infrastructure and GPU acceleration. Find out how scientists and software developers are using massive, highly parallel physics simulations and quantitative AI for drug discovery and materials science.
sprekers: Stefan Leichenauer (CTO, SandboxAQ); Mike Butcher (Founder, Pathfounders)

sprekers: Arthur Jordão (Executive Director, ESNA - Europe Startup Nations Alliance); James Ball (Political Editor, The New World)
organisaties: ESNA - Europe Startup Nations Alliance; The New World

This session shares a new framework for building brand trust that wins over both humans and the AI systems they rely on, with lessons from LEGO, Shopify and Patagonia on what actually moves the needle.
sprekers: Neil Barrie (Co-Founder & Global CEO, TwentyFirstCenturyBrand); Sofia Teixeira (Head of Digital, Razão Automóvel)

titel: Beyond unhinged: Duolingo’s next chapter
beschrijving: Duolingo became one of the world's most recognizable brands by mastering social media and embracing internet culture. But today’s marketing landscape is changing, as audiences fragment across platforms, creators, and communities. Join CMO Manu Orssaud as he explores their next phase of growth and discusses how companies can evolve from grabbing attention to building a brand people keep coming back to.
sprekers: Manu Orssaud (CMO, Duolingo)

titel: The mask in the mirror
beschrijving: As AI learns to imitate us, what decides who we become? As the face of DeepTomCruise and co-founder of Metaphysic, Miles Fisher has experienced synthetic identity from the inside, amassing over 5 million TikTok followers and 500 million views. In a funny, personal and visually compelling talk, he asks what happens when AI can convincingly manufacture almost anything, and argues that the scarce human skill will not be authenticity, but authorship.
sprekers: Miles Fisher (DeepTomCruise, Co-Founder, Metaphysic)

titel: Navigating AI in European health
beschrijving: Bridging frontier AI research with national health system execution, this session explores the operational realities, regulatory shifts, and governance required to deploy agentic AI safely across European healthcare.
sprekers: Aldo Faisal (Professor and Director, UKRI Centres in AI for Health at Imperial College London); Luís Goes Pinheiro (Chairman of the Board of Directors, SPMS); Elizabeth Dwoskin (Silicon Valley Correspondent, The Washington Post)
organisaties: UKRI Centres in AI for Health at Imperial College London; SPMS; The Washington Post

titel: AI wants your money. Can you trust it?
beschrijving: AI agents are starting to spend money, make financial decisions, and operate businesses autonomously. But why give them access before they've earned our trust? Just as identity and reputation govern human access, AI agents need the same. Humanos co-founder Pedro Andrade explores why AI needs a persistent identity and evolving risk and reputation profile to unlock financial services and autonomy. The future of AI isn't just about what agents can do. It's about what they're trusted to do.
sprekers: Pedro Andrade (Co-Founder & CEO, Humanos)

titel: Pricing the physical world

Lighthouse’s Sean Fitzpatrick and Pony.ai’s Leo Wang compare how each business forecasts demand, sets prices, and keeps its assets in use. Both build software that decides how physical assets get used. They’ll unpack how to serve radically different customers, where forecasts fall short, and what SaaS can learn from it.
sprekers: Leo Haojun Wang (Co-Founder & CFO, Pony.ai); Sean Fitzpatrick (CEO, Lighthouse); Susan Li (National Correspondent, Fox Business)

As users across Europe, Canada, and beyond reject dominant legacy platforms, a massive shift toward digital sovereignty is underway. Join Vivaldi CEO Jon von Tetzchner and Proton COO Raphael Auphan as they unpack what it actually takes to dismantle the traditional stack, defend consumer rights, and shape a more secure digital future.

titel: Designing your financial independence
beschrijving:
Financial independence isn’t just about money, it’s about having the freedom to choose how you spend your time. In this keynote, Rita Piçarra shares how she planned her path to financial independence and retired from corporate life at 44, after more than two decades in leadership roles. A practical and personal perspective on money, freedom, and taking ownership of the life you want to live.

This session is limited to 100 people, with spots available on a first-come, first-served basis.

titel: Open vs closed: The debate defining the AI era
beschrijving: As AI becomes a defining technology of the 21st century, a fundamental divide exists in how it is developed, shared and controlled. Broadly speaking, actors in China and the West are pursuing different strategies: open source collaboration vs proprietary models. This talk explores the strategic, economic, and political drivers behind openness versus control, including national security concerns, innovation incentives, and global competitiveness.
sprekers: Chon Tang (Founding Partner, Berkeley SkyDeck Fund); Alvin W. Graylin (Prof. AI Policy at UW | Digital Fellow, Stanford HAI); Carmem Domingues (former White House Senior AI Advisor, AI Techno-Realist, AI Techno-Realist @Carmemdom, Future Government Institute); Josh Dzieza (Feature Writer, The Verge)

This live demo will invite developers to build and extend this web and be among the first to contribute to the next internet.
sprekers: Babak Hodjat (Chief AI Officer, Cognizant)

sprekers: Johnny Rohrbach (Co-founder, Silverside AI)

beschrijving: Traditionally media outlets owned the content produced and talent got a salary or a fee but this has been replaced by something closer to a joint venture. This talk traces how podcasting made that shift possible, why hosts increasingly hold IP and equity stakes instead of just appearance fees, and what legacy and new outlets alike are having to renegotiate to keep top talent in the building.

Your Cycle Is Health Data: What It Can—and Can’t—Tell You is a conversation about spotting patterns, understanding the limits of tracking apps and why women’s health data matters.
sprekers: Claire Sanderson (Editor-in-Chief and Podcast Host, Women’s Health UK and Men’s Health UK); Rhiannon White (CEO, Clue)

Drawing on his experience co-founding Prosper AI, Xavier de Gracia shares how frontier companies draw on international networks across the US and Europe to build elite teams and scale globally in the AI era.

titel: The race for industrial AI: can Europe win?
beschrijving: How can Europe compete in the global AI race? Why does the block's industry have an inherent advantage? And which technologies will shape the future of manufacturing, infrastructure and industrial AI itself? Peter Koerte, Managing Board Member and President Smart Infrastructure at Siemens AG, makes the case for industrial AI as Europe's competitive edge - with examples from factories and infrastructure.
sprekers: Peter Koerte (Member of the Managing Board of Siemens AG and President Smart Infrastructure, Siemens AG)

titel: AI watched 25 years of news. What did it see?
beschrijving: What happens when you process 25 years of global news across 100+ languages through modern AI? In this keynote, GDELT Project founder Kalev Leetaru unpacks the hidden geopolitical and cultural trends uncovered from millions of hours of global media and the software engineering required to build it. Step under the hood of planetary-scale data architecture to see how real-time NLP, automated translation and petabyte-scale pipelines can transform decades of chaotic global noise into clean, queryable data that developers can use to build new intelligent tools.
sprekers: Kalev Leetaru (Founder, GDELT)

titel: Opening remarks
Zombie data: How your data comes back to haunt you
beschrijving: Is leaked data fueling hyper-personalised, AI-powered scams? Today’s cyber threats target trust rather than devices, using stolen profile data and session cookies to bypass passwords and MFA entirely. Traditional security asked if a file was dangerous, but modern security must ask if the moment itself is real.
sprekers: Domininkas Virbickas (Chief Product Strategy Officer, NordVPN)

titel: The election interference we don't talk about
beschrijving: Elections are no longer fought solely at the ballot box. They are contested on social media and online spaces. Here bots, troll farms and coordinated influence networks can shape public debate, amplify misleading narratives and manipulating perceptions of public opinion. This talk examines the Brazilian election, in addition to others. Beyond the headlines about misinformation, The Election Interference We Don’t Talk About asks a deeper question: who gets to shape the online conversation during an election, and what happens when the appearance of public opinion can be manufactured?
sprekers: Alan MacLeod (Senior Staff write Mint Press, author and member of the Glasgow University Media Group, Mint Press); Suzanne Nossel (Board Member, Meta Oversight Board); Anna Nemtsova (Foreign Correspondent, The Daily Beast)
organisaties: Mint Press; Meta Oversight Board; The Daily Beast

titel: Beyond matchday: the next era of fan experience
beschrijving: Football fandom is one of the most powerful forces connecting people across borders and generations. As technology transforms how fans engage with their favourite clubs, new opportunities are emerging to make those connections more meaningful, seamless and rewarding. From payments and ticketing to retail and matchday experiences, this conversation explores how football clubs and fintech partners are reimagining the fan experience, building stronger global communities and unlocking new opportunities for growth.
sprekers: Deborah Wajsbrot (Associate Director & Head of Partnerships, Revolut); Alex Rasmussen (Chief Revenue Officer, Como 1907); Ben Jacobs (Premier League Reporter & Senior Football Correspondent, GiveMeSport)

titel: Inside the making of MOURINHO
