sprekers: Miles Coleman (Producer & Head of Development, Ventureland & MOURINHO Documentary); Miguel Delaney (Chief Football Writer, The Independent)

titel: Open models, stronger ecosystems
beschrijving: Who gets to shape AI? Moonshot AI's answer is: everyone. Open models empower businesses and developers around the world to build, customise, and deploy AI around their own needs, supported by global inference providers. Following the launch of Kimi K3.1 Pro, Moonshot AI's most capable model to date, Director of International, Giacomo Ficari, shares the playbook for building ecosystems around open intelligence and taking frontier AI global.
sprekers: Giacomo Ficari (Director of International, Moonshot AI (Kimi))

titel: Startup Matchbox: Open innovation for everyone
beschrijving: Startup Matchbox gives companies and startups of every size access to open innovation. Hear from some of the matches it made: how they found each other, what worked, and what’s next.

titel: Build anything, anywhere
beschrijving: Ukraine has shown us that global disruptions burn through critical hardware faster than rigid assembly lines can replace it. Fragile overseas supply chains and multi-year factory tooling were built for a predictable world that no longer exists. Machina founder & CEO Edward Mehr breaks down the urgent shift toward decentralized production – revealing how networks of agile, software-defined factories deploy manufacturing directly to the point of need, securing industrial sovereignty across mobility, aerospace, and mission-critical supply chains.
sprekers: Edward Mehr (Co-Founder & CEO, Machina Labs); Graham Fraser (Senior Journalist, BBC News)

titel: What AI can do for humanity
beschrijving: In a tech landscape dominated by conversations about speed, efficiency, and scaling models, it’s easy to lose sight of why we build. Join Rodrigo Moran, Global Director of Creative at Microsoft as he cuts through the noise of AI hype to focus on what matters most: human-centric purpose. Discover how we can move beyond mere automation to design a future where AI truly serves humanity.
sprekers: Rodrigo Moran (Global Director of Creative, Microsoft)

titel: Just raised $320 million. Now what?
beschrijving: Otter.ai just raised $320 million, more than six times what it raised in its first decade. With AI squeezing SaaS and meeting notetakers multiplying, the bet is enterprise: turning 40 million users into paying teams. In this session Sam Liang dives into what the money is for and how a SaaS company thrives in the age of AI.
sprekers: Sam Liang (CEO and Co-Founder, Otter); Harry McCracken (Technology Editor, Fast Company)

titel: Beyond the dashboard: how AI agents are rewiring finance operations
beschrijving: Finance teams still lose days reconciling payments, chasing invoices and updating systems by hand. Now, AI agents are moving beyond copilots and dashboards to take ownership of entire workflows. Caitlin, co-founder and CEO of Fazeshift, reveals why accounts receivable is becoming a proving ground for autonomous finance and what happens when software stops surfacing insights and starts owning outcomes.
sprekers: Caitlin Leksana (Co-Founder & CEO, Fazeshift)

titel: Just what the dev ordered: Healthcare’s AI revolution
beschrijving: Healthcare is notorious for its fragmented legacy software. Join Stellarus CTO Greg Ryslik as they discuss how today's engineers are rewriting the rules of clinical technology. Explore the modern data infrastructure behind a universal healthcare platform and see how developers can solve legacy healthcare problems.
sprekers: Greg Ryslik (Chief Technology Officer, Stellarus); Julian Issa (Host, Beyond Tomorrow Podcast)

titel: Putting human rights into artificial intelligence
beschrijving: AI companies, such as Anthropic, have begun to think about the ethical implications of their transformative technologies by embedding a human rights respecting constitution into their AI. Should this approach become an industry standard to ensure that AI models adhere to the same moral and ethical standards as humans? Or should governments impose these standards from without?
sprekers: Michael O'Flaherty (Commissioner for Human Rights, Council of Europe); Gian M. Volpicelli (Technology Reporter, Bloomberg)

titel: Who wins when AI does the shopping?
beschrijving: For 25 years, retailers have competed to bring customers to their stores and influence what they buy. AI is beginning to change that equation. When an AI agent discovers, compares, and recommends, who controls the shopping decision? Maju Kuruvilla, Founder and CEO of Spangle AI and ex-Amazon VP, explores what retailers stand to lose, where new opportunities emerge, and how they can compete.
sprekers: Maju Kuruvilla (CEO and Founder, Spangle); Boaz Sobrado (Host, On the Margin)

titel: Securing the AI frontline
beschrijving: Modern conflict no longer stays in the cloud. As state-sponsored actors and advanced cybercriminals target autonomous systems, critical infrastructure, and military hardware, the front line of cyber defense has been pushed to the limit. Now, it’s up to democratic nations to adapt, respond, and secure the tactical edge.
sprekers: Giovanni Alberto Falcione (Co-founder & CTO, Exein); Michael Howard (Chief Product Officer, Whitespace); Mehul Srivastava (Senior Foreign Affairs Correspondent, Financial Times)

titel: CX in the Age of AI 👥
beschrijving:

This session is limited to 100 people, with spots available on a first-come, first-served basis.
sprekers: Cristiani Oliveira (Partner & COO, Lab Experience)

titel: Growth has rules: Speed breaks 'em
beschrijving: The growth playbook you're proud of might be the very thing slowing you down. Neha helped write the growth playbook at Twitter and Pinterest. Then she left to found JustAI and had to unlearn a lot of it. Starting from the ground up, Neha rethought what she knew, adapted and proved her assumptions wrong more than once. The rules survived, but the pace didn’t. What took weeks now takes hours. Trying is almost free and extremely fast, so the fastest teams set the records. In this talk, Neha shares what she unlearned, the rules that held up and how to keep those rules while breaking every record.
sprekers: Neha Mittal (Co-Founder & CEO, JustAI)

titel: The next billion players will not download a game
beschrijving: Games used to be products people searched for and downloaded. AI is making games easier and cheaper to create, intensifying competition for players’ attention. The advantage is no longer just making great games, but ensuring they get discovered and building lasting relationships with players. Bozena Rezab, CEO and Co-founder of GAMEE, explores what happens to the gaming industry when anyone can make a game.
sprekers: Bozena Rezab (Co-founder & Chairperson, Gamee); Jakub Ostrowski (Sports Presenter, Polsat News)

titel: Western tech: All is not lost
beschrijving: Between aggressive state-backed tech models, supply chain rifts, and escalating geopolitical rivalries, headlines are quick to declare the decline of Western tech dominance. But is the game truly lost, or merely entering a more volatile, competitive chapter? Join leaders from Jasper, Legora, and Picsart as they examine the real state of play and what it will actually take to stay competitive on an increasingly divided global stage.
sprekers: Jacob Lauritzen (CTO, Legora); Mikayel Vardanyan (Co Founder & COO, Picsart); Katie Collins (Principal Writer, CNET)

What does this entail for the future of humanity?
sprekers: Sam Pasupalak (Co-founder & CEO, Skyfall AI)

titel: Health's data shift: From episodic care to continuous prevention
beschrijving: Healthcare has long relied on sporadic snapshots like annual check-ups. Join Dor Kilroy, CCO at Oura, as she explores how continuous wearable data shifts medicine from reactive treatment to proactive prevention, and what it takes to scale those insights into better health outcomes.
sprekers: Dor Kilroy (Chief Commercial Officer, Oura); Katherine Ward (Network Health Reporter, Global News)

beschrijving: A high-end short used to cost $500k. 'Website', winner of the Reply AI Film Festival, was made for $7k by the independent team behind DiDi_OK, with Jiaze leading the AI visuals from a single laptop. AI makes filmmaking more accessible, but great storytelling still requires human creativity and vision.
sprekers: Jiaze Li (AI Director, WPP)

titel: The World Cup effect: Portugal's global ambition
beschrijving: Portugal’s presence at the FIFA World Cup created an opportunity to showcase its football identity to a global audience. Nuno Gomes, Former Portugal international & High Performance Specialist at FIFA; João Medeiros Cardoso, Chief Marketing & Commercial Officer at the Portuguese Football Federation; discuss how commercial strategy, sponsorship and tourism can turn that visibility into lasting international growth and build a football powerhouse.
sprekers: João Medeiros Cardoso (Chief Marketing & Commercial Officer, Portuguese Football Federation); Nuno Gomes (Footballer & High Performance Specialist, FIFA); Margarida Borrego (Host, Megahits)

titel: Pricing SaaS when users are agents
beschrijving: Per-seat pricing assumed a human was at the keyboard. As AI agents take over the work, the seat is a poor measure of value. LaunchDarkly charges for usage, not seats. Mindstone made his AI agent system free for up to 100 users, because the real value was in getting people to change how they work. They discuss what to charge for when the software itself is close to free.
sprekers: Edith Harbaugh (Co-founder & CEO, LaunchDarkly); Joshua Wöhle (CEO, Mindstone); Jeremy Goldman (VP, Editorial & Insights, Rethink Retail)

titel: Decoding planet Earth
beschrijving: Current AI models excel at predicting words, but understanding physical events in real time is a whole different challenge. The next AI frontier will be to teach machines how to perceive physical environments as they change. Developers will get a clear look at how systems ingest real-world signals, from live news and geodata to visual inputs, to better understand the world around us.
sprekers: Kalev Leetaru (Founder, GDELT); Dustin Tran (Chief Reasoning Architect, Elorian)

titel: Woke 3.0: The next generation of the culture wars?
beschrijving: From the social justice activism of Woke 1.0, through the backlash and recalibration of Woke 2.0, to Hasan Piker’s tongue-in-cheek declaration of Woke 3.0, progressive politics may be entering a new phase. But what has really changed? Is the left reclaiming its cultural confidence, shifting towards class and economic populism, or simply repackaging old battles for a new political moment? This talk explores the evolution of woke politics, the forces driving its reinvention and what Woke 3.0 might mean for the future of the American left.
sprekers: Nathan J Robinson (English American writer, editor of Current Affairs Magazine whose latest book is couathored with Noam Chomsky, Current Affairs); DeRay Mckesson (Civil Rights Activist & Podcaster, Pod Save The People); Miriam Cates (Former MP and Commentator, The Centre for Social Justice); Steve Clemons (Host of The Bottom Line; Editor at Large, National Interest, Al Jazeera English)
organisaties: Current Affairs; Pod Save The People; The Centre for Social Justice; Al Jazeera English

sprekers: Bjarne Johannsen (Co-founder & CTO, Sensmore)

Discover which capabilities command high rates, which roles are vanishing and how professionals can adapt to stay competitive.

This panel dissects the operational realities, mental discipline and strategic advantage of building a startup from hotel rooms, locker rooms and international travel schedules.
sprekers: Priscilla Hon (Professional Tennis Player & Co-Founder, Invisible Skin); Dylan Gee (Former pro tennis player and coach, creator of 'Tennis With Dylan', Tenniswithdylan); Paul Rhodes (Senior Director, Audience & Magazines, Newsweek)

titel: The real threat isn’t a nation-state, it’s a teenager.
beschrijving: Are you defending against headlines or reality? Most organizations spend millions defending against nation-state threats, while the attackers who actually get in fly under the radar. Join The Hacking Games CPO John Madelin and former child hacker Conor Freeman for a live ACE demo with the latest attack data captured from young hackers. Get inside the mind of an AI-equipped attacker to see where security is failing today and how to fix your real vulnerabilities.
sprekers: John Madelin (Chief Product Officer, The Hacking Games); Conor Freeman (Former Black Hat Hacker & Offensive Security Lead, The Hacking Games)

titel: The smartphone in your pocket is your next lab

sprekers: Danielle Perszyk (Co-founder & CEO, Prosper)

sprekers: Chris Adams (Founder & CEO, Hey Honey)

sprekers: Jia Xie (SVP, Autoflight Aviation)

titel: The business behind the badge
Betting against the moat

In this session, Caitlin and Rocio debate whether a 'moat' still means anything in enterprise software, or whether it's just what the losing side says on the way out.

This panel breaks down actionable self-defence strategies to empower enterprises, infrastructure leaders, and citizens to adapt, overcome, and thrive in an increasingly hostile cyber world.

He highlights how these innovations are disrupting one of the oldest and most foundational heavy industries in the world, and identifies other underserved fields ready for similar disruption. For innovators and investors, the challenge made is to bet on humanity by building AI for the most critical physical-world problems.

So every action routes back through you, and you end up as the agent's "meat proxy." Spinnable ID fixes this by giving the AI you already use its own name, face, email address and WhatsApp presence, so it can act on your behalf like a real executive assistant and talk directly to people and to other agents. Join Spinnable Founder Vasco Pedro as he walks through the full flow on stage. You'll see onboarding over WhatsApp, how the Spinnable MCP lets Claude take on its own identity, and the agent handling real tasks in the world. The demo puts developer use cases front and center, along with what it means to build on an identity layer that works across harnesses, starting with Claude and ChatGPT.
sprekers: Vasco Pedro (Co-founder & CEO, Spinnable.ai)

titel: Deus ex machina: Can AI replace God?
beschrijving: Religion and mythology have been used, for millenia, to seize power. As AI progresses in its capabilities, the narratives around it are taking on an increasingly religious, or theistic, tone. In this session we explore how these shifts in language are used by elites to obtain and entrench their power. Can AI replace God, and if it can, what does that mean for us?
sprekers: Remington Tonar (Co-Founder, Cart.com); João Maldonado (Journalist, Grupo Renascença  Multimédia)

titel: Beyond the front door: Identity, access, and user trust
beschrijving: AI deepfakes don’t stop at the front door, they target every stage of the user lifecycle from initial onboarding to internal access. But stronger security shouldn't come at the cost of privacy. Join CEO of Persona, Rick Song as he explores how identity verification and privileged access management converge to prevent fraud and protect privacy.
sprekers: Rick Song (CEO, Persona); Cristina Nascimento (Journalist, Rádio Renascença)

titel: The path to processing US$10bn in payments
beschrijving: Compliance cannot be a bottleneck if you want to scale, and regulation has to be approached as a partnership, not an obstacle. Bernardo shares how building local banking relationships market by market, rather than trying to route around them, turned Trace Finance into core infrastructure for four of the world's largest payment providers operating in LatAm.
sprekers: Bernardo Brites (Co-Founder & CEO, Trace Finance)

titel: Hollywood's identity crisis
beschrijving: Deepfakes and generative AI are creating new threats to Hollywood, putting the likeness, voice and creative rights of artists at risk. As the technology races ahead, who gets to decide how an artist’s identity is used? Dan Neely and Duncan Crabtree-Ireland explore how the industry can protect performers from exploitation while using the same technology to safeguard their rights and put control back in their hands.
sprekers: Dan Neely (Co-Founder and CEO, Vermillio); Duncan Crabtree-Ireland (National Executive Director & CEO, SAG-AFTRA); Stewart Clarke (SVP, Content, International, Deadline)

titel: Digital transformation and dynamism in service delivery
beschrijving: How can governments and international organisations use digital technology to make public services faster, simpler and more accessible? This talk discusses how modernisation is increasingly taking the form of AI, digital identity and online services, along with the challenges around security, inclusion and implementation at scale.
sprekers: Luis Alberto Rodriguez (Economist, and former Deputy Minister, Colombian Government); Tristan Thomas (Director for Customer First, Department for Science, Innovation & Technology); Amanda Lima (Executive Director, DN Brasil)
organisaties: Colombian Government; Department for Science, Innovation & Technology; DN Brasil

titel: The cognitive city: Where AI acts, not just sees
beschrijving: Cities, stadiums, stores and hospitals are full of sensors but short on action. This session explores how agentic and physical AI close the loop, with real examples and a clear view of where builders can win.
sprekers: Renu Navale (VP & GM, Health and Cities Division, Edge Computing Group, Intel); David Savage (Podcast Host & Group Technology Evangelist, Harvey Nash)

titel: Scaling what cannot be standardized
beschrijving: Industrial software is difficult to scale because every company operates under different constraints, meaning companies cannot easily standardise their operations. ALGO ARTIS grew by identifying the common structures beneath complex problems and turning each deployment into reusable technology, software and industry knowledge. Kentaro shares why this alone is not enough – and how scaling across energy, manufacturing, and logistics also requires different approaches to customisation, pricing and product strategy for each market.
sprekers: Kentaro Nagata (Co-Founder & CEO, ALGO ARTIS)

titel: Is VC playing it too safe?
beschrijving: Venture capital was built to fund the impossible, yet a decade of cheap capital has turned it into a consensus-driven machine chasing safe metrics. Outsized returns require solitary conviction. Join this session as we move past the hype to explore the true mechanics of contrarian investing, finding non-obvious opportunities, and spotting frontier markets years before they become obvious.
sprekers: Rohit Sharma (Partner, True Ventures); Pedro Santos Vieira (Partner, 500 Global); Nikhilesh De (Managing Editor, Global Policy & Regulation, CoinDesk)

titel: Integration or assimilation? The immigration debate
beschrijving: Immigration is reshaping European politics, with parties once on the margins now winning significant support amid public concern over housing, security and national identity. Governments have responded with measures ranging from tighter border controls to reduced work permits. Our panel asks: what do we expect of newcomers once they arrive? Should they adopt the host society’s culture and norms through assimilation, or should societies make room for cultural difference within a shared civic framework via integration?
sprekers: Mike Howell (President, Oversight Project); Miriam Cates (Former MP and Commentator, The Centre for Social Justice); Raphael Minder (Central Europe correspondent, Financial Times)
organisaties: Oversight Project; The Centre for Social Justice; Financial Times

titel: Game developers: Your next key hire
beschrijving: As AI reshapes skill requirements across industries, the games industry offers a growing pool of adaptable systems thinkers and creative problem solvers. With audience attention at a premium, are game developers the key to unlocking the next level of user engagement?
sprekers: Brian Baglow (Founder, Scottish Games Network); Cláudio Pestana (Project Manager, eGames Lab)

titel: How the world’s biggest companies move money
beschrijving: Tech companies scale across borders faster than ever, selling to global markets and hiring distributed teams from day one. But legacy finance can’t keep up. Learn how to navigate contractor payroll, multi-currency conversions and cross-border settlements and why building scalable epayments early is vital for global expansion.
sprekers: Serhii Zakharov (Founder and CEO, PayDo); Guilherme Murtinho (Founding partner & VP Europe, Transfero Group); Evan Bourke (Journalist & Producer, Independent)

titel: Hormones as the next frontier of women’s longevity and healthspan
beschrijving: Women spend 25% more of their lives in poor health than men, yet female-specific conditions receive just 1% of non-oncology research. This talk explores how continuous, non-invasive hormone monitoring turns an overlooked blind spot into actionable data, opening a new market for personalised and accessible healthcare and laying the groundwork for world models of human health. Clair Health’s 22-year-old founder shares how she built the scientific rigour and consumer trust needed to raise an $11.6M seed round for the first non-invasive continuous hormone-monitoring wearable and the opportunity ahead.
sprekers: Jenny Duan (Co-Founder & CEO, Clair Health)

titel: Who gets a say in football’s future?
beschrijving: Football belongs to billions, yet the people who play, watch and love the game rarely have a say in how it evolves. World Cup winner and Common Goal co-founder Juan Mata joins Jürgen Griesbeck, co-founder of Common Goal and C-Lab, to introduce Unleash Football, an initiative designed to give football's global community a greater voice in shaping the game's future. They'll share early insights from voices around the world, what people want from football and what they believe needs to change, before inviting the audience to add their voice live.
sprekers: Juan Mata (Investor & Co-founder, C-Lab, Unleash Football); Jürgen Griesbeck (Co-founder, C-Lab); Nicky Crosby (TV presenter & Radio Host, Sky Sports News)
organisaties: C-Lab, Unleash Football; C-Lab; Sky Sports News

titel: From missing sunlight to a growth story
beschrijving: We spend 90% of our waking hours indoors, missing the near-infrared part of sunlight our bodies evolved to need. Yet turning a scientific insight like this into a business is where many science founders get stuck: even groundbreaking research rarely becomes validated, scalable health technology on its own. Discover how to build on evidence instead of following wellness hypes, why launching a first product early matters for founders with a science background, and how licensing your technology into devices people already use can unlock scale. Plus a first look at what comes next.
sprekers: Anne Berends (CEO, CTO and co-founder, SunLED Life Science)

titel: Investigative journalism under threat
beschrijving: Investigative journalism faces mounting threats across the UK and Europe, including restrictive libel laws, misuse of privacy claims, SLAPPs, intimidation and reputational attacks. This panel will examine efforts to silence critical reporting, the protection available to journalists, and how online safety laws, platform moderation and algorithms may affect independent media.
sprekers: James Ball (Political Editor, The New World); Paul Holden (Director of Investigations, author and journalist, Shadow World); Eoghan McNeill (Co-founder, The Ditch)
organisaties: The New World; Shadow World; The Ditch

titel: The instant economy: Why are we still waiting for our own money?
beschrijving: Despite real-time rails and instant settlement capabilities, everyday finance remains bound by legacy schedules. This discussion examines the shift to instant payments, earned wage access, and how real-time money movement impacts risk, regulation, and consumer flexibility.
sprekers: Atif Siddiqi (Founder & CEO, Branchapp); Prabhakar Reddy (Founder & CEO, OpenFX); Amanda Aronczyk (Co-host, Planet Money, National Public Radio)

titel: From AI prototypes to trusted business software
beschrijving: 2026 was the era of shiny demos and prototypes. 2027 will be the era of useful, secure business software that powers your business operations. This talk unveils how the next generation of business apps will be built by non-technical teams - without compromising security, governance, or control.
sprekers: Mariam Hakobyan (CEO, Softr)

titel: Rewriting the rules of female longevity
beschrijving: Women’s health has long been approached in fragments, often reactive and disconnected, leaving major gaps in how women understand their bodies and navigate different stages of life. This session introduces a new product that brings together health intelligence, personalization and technology to help women take a more proactive role in living healthier for longer. What could a new approach to female longevity look like?
sprekers: Daniela Braga (Founder & CEO, Defined.ai); Cristina Ferreira (TV Host, Executive, TVI)

titel: Agents don't need prompts, they need context
beschrijving: Most AI initiatives stall because autonomous tools remain siloed from real-time decision-making, history, and human intent. Serial founder and product leader Milkana Brace explores how building a continuous context layer bridges the gap between human creativity and autonomous execution at scale.
sprekers: Milkana Brace (Co-Founder & CPO, SageOx)

titel: Microdramas and the rise of the one-person studio
beschrijving: Microdramas are on track to become a $14B global market this year, and AI is speeding up how they’re made. One AI-native series from a first-time creator grossed close to $1M on StoReel. StoReel co-founder and co-CEO Angela Yu explains why AI entertainment, gaming and content are merging: characters you can talk to, plots you can steer, worlds audiences help shape. And how do you scale a format that’s still being invented?
sprekers: Angela Yu (Co-founder & Co-CEO, StoReel)

titel: The blueprint for universal care at scale
beschrijving: What does it take to give millions of people universal access to quality healthcare? knok CEO José Bastos shares lessons from more than 2 million telemedicine appointments and from taking direct responsibility for primary care, showing how AI, automated patient journeys and dedicated clinical teams can deliver better health at scale.
sprekers: Jose Bastos (Co-founder & CEO, knok healthcare)
